来.o: Simplified form of 來. Pictograph of a stalk of wheat. The current meaning "come" is a phonetic loan. The original meaning "wheat" is now written as 麥.
w: to stand up; to get up
to come out; to appear; to arise
to come over; to manage; to handle
to bring; to bring about; to produce
x: 我不知道它是从哪里来的。
Wǒ bù zhīdào tā shì cóng nǎlǐ lái de.
I didn't know where it came from.
这主意听起来不错。
Zhè zhǔyì tīng qǐlai bùcuò.
That sounds like a good idea.
我看出来怎么用了。
Wǒ kàn chūlái zěnme yòng le.
I figured out (after observation) how to use it.

w: by means of; thereby, therefore; consider as
to think (i.e. to take it to be true that ...) (Usually there is…
that level or higher; that amount or more
x: 价格在一千元以上。
Jiàgé zài yīqiān yuán yǐshàng.
The price is above one thousand yuan.
你不可以走。
Nǐ bù kěyǐ zǒu.
You may not leave.
他是南方人，所以一张口说话就带有南方口音。
Tā shì nánfāngrén, suǒyǐ yī zhāngkǒu shuōhuà jiù dàiyǒu nánfāng kǒuyīn.
He is from the South, so when he opens his mouth to speak, you can hear his Southern accent.

c.h: Transfer of knowledge is done through speech.

知.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 矢 represents the sound.
w: to know; to become aware of
to find out; to know; to learn about
x: 你知不知道他的名字？
Nǐ zhī bù zhīdào tā de míngzi?
Do you know his name?
我们不知道。
Wǒmen bù zhīdào.
We don't know.
图书馆是人类知识的海洋。
Túshūguǎn shì rénlèi zhīshi de hǎiyáng.
Libraries contain knowledge of human experience as vast as the open sea.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

別.o: Depicts a knife (刂) cutting meat off of a bone （冎）.

该.o: Simplified form of 該. Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 亥 represents the sound.
x: 我该去睡了。
Wǒ gāi qù shuì le.
I must go to sleep now.
不用谢，这是我应该的。
Bùyòngxiè, zhè shì wǒ yīnggāi de.
No need to thank me — it's been a pleasure.
你不该干涉他的私事。
Nǐ bùgāi gānshè tā de sīshì.
You should not interfere with his private business.

w: day; a (calendar) date; days of one's life
x: 这是我特意为你生日而做的。
Zhè shì wǒ tèyì wèi nǐ shēngrì ér zuò de.
I made this specially for your birthday.
过些日子我们再见。
Guò xiē rìzi wǒmen zàijiàn.
We will see each other again after quite some time.
他正在写日记呢。
Tā zhèngzài xiě rìjì ne.
He's writing in his diary.

工.o: Depicts a tool with a blade.
w: to work; (of a machine) to operate; job
x: 你做什么工？
Nǐ zuò shénme gōng?
What is your job?
你以为我在工作，其实我在玩。
Nǐ yǐwéi wǒ zài gōngzuò, qíshí wǒ zài wán.
You thought I was working, but I was actually having fun.
员工返岗前必须洗手。
Yuángōng fǎngǎng qián bìxū xǐshǒu.
Employees must wash hands before returning to work.

入.o: Arrow pointing forward, representing the idea "enter".
w: to enter; to join; to go into
to become a member; to join; to mix into
to throw into; to put into
to sink into; to get caught up in
x: 我们进入下一个议题吧。
Wǒmen jìnrù xià yīge yìtí ba.
Let's move on to the next topic.
所得税的多少取决于你的收入。
Suǒdéshuì de duōshǎo qǔjué yú nǐ de shōurù.
How much income tax you pay depends on your income.
投入硬币。
Tóurù yìngbì.
Insert coin.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

接.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 妾 represents the sound.
w: to approach; to get close to
to catch and hold on; to continue
to link; to join; to attach
x: 不用道歉，我不会接受。
Bùyòng dàoqiàn, wǒ bùhuì jiēshòu.
Don’t apologize. I won’t accept it.
他让我直接联系局长。
Tā ràng wǒ zhíjiē liánxì júzhǎng.
He asked me to contact the director directly.
我在这里接触了这么多的新鲜事物，我真是大开眼界。
Wǒ zài zhèlǐ jiēchù le zhème duō de xīnxiān shìwù, wǒ zhēnshì dàkāiyǎnjiè.
I have come into contact with so many new things here — it's been really eye-opening.

c.h: Shorthand for the 㚔 component in the traditional character 報.

报.o: Simplified form of 報. Depicts a person being subdued (𠬝) by shackles (㚔). Based on the original meaning "punish". The meaning later shifted to "revenge", "recompense", "report", and "announce".
w: to inform; to report; to make known
x: 我要报一宗盗窃案。
Wǒ yào bào yī zōng dàoqiè àn.
I want to report a theft.
付出一定会有回报。
Fùchū yīdìng huì yǒu huíbào.
You will surely be rewarded if you put in some effort.
这个公司报亏损之后，价格就下滑。
Zhè ge gōngsī bào kuīsǔn zhīhòu, jiàgé jiù xiàhuá.
The price went down after the company reported a loss.

查.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 且 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "hawthorn tree", now written as 柤. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: to look over; to examine; to check up
to examine; to investigate; to censor out
x: 检查不够严格。
Jiǎnchá bùgòu yángé.
The inspection was not sufficiently rigorous.
滑动查看更多。
Huádòng chákàn gèng duō.
Swipe to see more.
仔细检查以免出错。
Zǐxì jiǎnchá yǐmiǎn chūcuò.
Check carefully to avoid mistakes.

步.o: Pictograph of one foot in front of another, depicting footsteps.
w: one step further; to move forward a step
to take a walk; to go for a walk
x: 科学技术时刻都在进步。
Kēxué jìshù shíkè dōu zài jìnbù.
Science and technology is constantly improving.
这事情怎么会搞到这种地步？
Zhè shìqíng zěnme huì gǎo dào zhè zhǒng dìbù?
How did this matter end up like this?
书籍是人类进步的阶梯。
Shūjí shì rénlèi jìnbù de jiētī.
The book is the ladder of human progress.

哥.o: Duplicate of 可, which has a similar sound.
w: older male cousin via female line
x: 他是我的哥哥。他比我大两岁。
Tā shì wǒ de gēge. Tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì.
He is my elder brother. He is two years older than I.
哥们儿，你已经走了吗？
Gēmenr, nǐ yǐjīng zǒu le ma?
Dude, have you left already?

营.o: Simplified form of 營. Phonosemantic compound. 宮 represents the meaning and 荧 represents the sound.
w: to engage in (business etc); to run
to be in operation; to do business
x: 速食面虽然方便，但没有营养。
Sùshímiàn suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn méiyǒu yíngyǎng.
Instant noodles might be convenient, but they do not have much nutritional value.
节假日照常营业。
Jiéjiàrì zhàocháng yíngyè.
Open on weekends and public holidays.
节假日不营业。
Jiéjiàrì bù yíngyè.
Closed on weekends and public holidays.

c.h: The traditional component 敢 was removed for simplification.

严.o: Simplified form of 嚴. Phonosemantic compound. 喦 represents the meaning and 敢 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "exaggerate". The meaning later shifted to "extreme", "severe", and "strict". The traditional component 敢 was removed for simplification.
x: 这里疫情很严重。
Zhèlǐ yìqíng hěn yánzhòng.
The epidemic situation here is very serious.
检查不够严格。
Jiǎnchá bùgòu yángé.
The inspection was not sufficiently rigorous.
特区应严肃处理公务员违规事件。
Tèqū yīng yánsù chǔlǐ gōngwùyuán wéiguī shìjiàn.
Special administrative regions should seriously punish civil servants who violate regulations.

鬥.o: Pictograph of two people wrestling each other.

c.h: 艹 is a component form of 艸.

藥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 艹 represents the meaning and 樂 represents the sound.

c.h: Depicts a hand smoothing out the hair.

若.o: Pictograph of a kneeling person smoothing out their unkempt hair with their hands. Based on the original meaning "conform, obey". The 口 (mouth) component was added later when the character became more abstract.
w: a certain number or amount; how many?
overwhelmed by favor from superior (humble expr.)
as if nothing had happened (idiom); calmly
were it not for; if not for
x: 天若有情天亦老。
Tiān ruò yǒu qíng tiān yì lǎo.
If Heaven had feelings, Heaven too would grow old.
你若不离不弃，我必生死相依。
Nǐ ruò bùlíbùqì, wǒ bì shēngsǐxiàngyī.
If you do not leave me, I will be by your side until the life ends.

急.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 及 represents the sound.
x: 紧急时击破玻璃。
Jǐnjí shí jīpò bōli.
Break glass in emergency.
我觉得很着急，我该怎么办啊？
Wǒ juéde hěn zháojí, wǒ gāi zěnmebàn a?
I feel worried. What should I do?
紧急时请按按钮。
Jǐnjí shí qǐng àn ànniǔ.
Press button in emergency.

略.o: Phonosemantic compound. 田 represents the meaning and 各 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "demarcate land boundaries". The meaning later shifted to "outline" and "approximately".
w: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore
to have a taste of; to realize; to appreciate
x: 他从来很冷静，很策略。
Tā cónglái hěn lěngjìng, hěn cèlüè.
He is always calm and tactful.
公文中使用缩略语需遵守规范。
Gōngwén zhōng shǐyòng suōlüèyǔ xū zūnshǒu guīfàn.
The use of abbreviations in official documents must follow the prescribed standards.

c.h: Depicts a hidden corner or a container.

奥.o: Simplified form of 奧. Depicts two hands (廾) hiding rice (米) in a corner or a container. Based on the original meaning "to store". The meaning later shifted to "obscure", "profound", and "mysterious".
x: 从遗憾里发觉做人不必很深奥，糊涂才是美。
Cóng yíhàn lǐ fājué zuòrén bù bì hěn shēn'ào, hútú cái shì měi.
From regrets discovering [that] one does not need to live a complicated life, being foolish is [true] beauty.
奥运会的时候，我们关注金牌的运动员。
Àoyùnhuì de shíhou, wǒmen guānzhù jīnpái de yùndòngyuán.
During the Olympics we pay special attention to gold medalists.

句.o: 口 represents the sound and 丩 represents the meaning and the sound.
x: 他一共也没说几句话。
Tā yīgòng yě méi shuō jǐ jù huà.
He didn't say much. [lit. He didn't say many sentences.]
这个句子有点儿奇怪。
Zhè ge jùzi yǒudiǎnr qíguài.
This sentence is a little strange.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

挥.o: Simplified form of 揮. Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 军 represents the sound.
w: to conduct; to command; to direct
x: 他今天比赛发挥得很好。
Tā jīntiān bǐsài fāhuī de hěn hǎo.
He performed very well in today's match.
她笑着向我们挥手。
Tā xiào zhe xiàng wǒmen huīshǒu.
She smiled and waved to us.

麥.o: The top component 來 depicts a stalk of wheat. The bottom component depicts roots.

c.h: 攵 is a component form of 攴.

败.o: Phonosemantic compound. 攵 represents the meaning and 贝 represents the sound. Simplified form of 敗.
w: to defeat; to overpower; to beat
x: 菊花败了。
Júhuā bài le.
The chrysanthemums have withered.
他们的计划注定要失败。
Tāmen de jìhuà zhùdìng yào shībài.
Their plan is doomed to fail.
我真失败。
Wǒ zhēn shībài.
I am such a failure.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

拥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 用 represents the sound. Simplified form of 擁.
x: 人与其他生物最大的不同，就是拥有文明。
Rén yǔ qítā shēngwù zuìdà de bùtóng, jiùshì yōngyǒu wénmíng.
The ability to develop civilizations is the biggest difference between humans and other living things.
这位男孩被拥立为王。
Zhè wèi nánhái bèi yōnglì wéi wáng.
The boy was proclaimed king.

春.o: Phonosemantic compound. 日 and 艹 represent the meaning and 屯 represents the sound.
w: (increased) passenger transportation around Chinese New Year
spring and autumn; four seasons; year
x: 春风送来春天的问候。
Chūnfēng sòng lái chūntiān de wènhòu.
Spring greets us with its warm breeze.
北京的春天很适合骑车逛胡同。
Běijīng de chūntiān hěn shìhé qíchē guàng hútòng.
Beijing’s spring is very suitable for cycling around the hutongs.

c.h: 衤 is a component form of 衣.

补.o: Phonosemantic compound. 衤 represents the meaning and 卜 represents the sound. Simplified form of 補.
w: to replenish; to supplement; to complement
to complement; to make up for a deficiency
to replace (a damaged component with a new one, an injured player…
to fill a gap; to fill in a blank (on a form)
x: 记得多吃苹果哦，补充维他命。
Jìde duō chī píngguǒ ò, bǔchōng wéitāmìng.
Remember to eat more apples to get more vitamins.
我要弥补我的过错。
Wǒ yào míbǔ wǒ de guòcuò.
I want to make amends for what I did.
各位还有什么需要补充的吗？
Gèwèi háiyǒu shénme xūyào bǔchōng de ma?
Does anyone have anything they would like to add?

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

健.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 建 represents the sound.
w: to exercise; to keep fit; to work out
x: 祝你身体健康，万事如意。
Zhù nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng, wànshìrúyì.
Wish you good health, and all the best.
我家的树长得很健康。
Wǒ jiā de shù zhǎng dé hěn jiànkāng.
The tree in my house is growing healthily.

啥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 舍 represents the sound.
x: 你说啥来着？
Nǐ shuō shà láizhe?
What did you just say?
你说啥来著？
Nǐ shuō shà láizhe?
What did you just say?

c.h: 钅 is a component form of 金.

钥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 钅 represents the meaning and 月 represents the sound. Simplified form of 鑰.
x: 奶奶老是忘带钥匙。
Nǎinai lǎoshì wàng dài yàoshi.
Grandma always forgets her keys.
他四处寻找丢失的钥匙。
Tā sìchù xúnzhǎo diūshī de yàoshi.
He looked here and there for the missing keys.

童.o: Depicts a tool (辛) piercing through a person's eye (目). This was usually given as punishment to criminals. 東 was added later to represent the sound. Based on the original meaning "male criminal". The meaning later shifted to "boy servant" (now written as 僮) and "child".
x: 这家商店童鞋有现货。
Zhè jiā shāngdiàn tóngxié yǒu xiànhuò.
The store had children's shoes in stock.
她根本就没有童年。
Tā gēnběn jiù méiyǒu tóngnián.
She didn't have any kind of childhood.
那个病童的情况今天看起来比昨天更不妙。
Nà ge bìngtóng de qíngkuàng jīntiān kànqǐlái bǐ zuótiān gèng bùmiào.
The sick child looks still worse today than yesterday.

c.h: Depicts something being pulled by two hands. Unrelated to 𠂤, even though it looks identical in the modern form.

帥.o: Depicts two hands pulling a long, vertical object. The original meaning is variously explained as pulling with a rope, or a belt-like garment. The meaning later shifted to "lead", "commander", and "handsome".

桥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 乔 represents the sound. Simplified form of 橋.
w: either end of a bridge; a bridgehead
x: 这座老桥给炸掉了。
Zhè zuò lǎo qiáo gěi zhàdiào le.
The old bridge has been blown up.
前方桥低。
Qiánfāng qiáo dī.
Low bridge ahead.

紥.o: To bind 扎 with thread 糸
w: to camp; to pitch camp; stationed

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

津.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 聿 represents the sound.
w: to be of no interest to anyone (idiom)
to make inquiries; to show interest
bodily fluids (general term in Chinese medicine)
x: 中国有北京、上海、天津、重庆等四个直辖市。
Zhōngguó yǒu Běijīng, Shànghǎi, Tiānjīn, Chóngqìng děng sì ge zhíxiáshì.
China has four direct-administered municipalities: Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, and Chongqing.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

肥.o: Depicts a person (卩) with extra flesh (肉) on their body.
w: fat (e.g. pork fat); fatty meat; a gold mine
x: 农场里的小猪长得肥肥的，好可爱。
Nóngchǎng lǐ de xiǎozhū zhǎng de féiféi de, hǎo kě'ài.
The pigs in the farm are quite plump, very cute.
他的裤子太短，外套和背心又太肥大。
Tā de kùzi tài duǎn, wàitào hé bèixīn yòu tài féidà.
His trousers were too short and his coat and vest too loose.

臥.o: Depicts a person (人) with their eye (臣) leaning forward preparing to lie down and sleep.
w: to hide (as an undercover agent); a mole
to lie down; to drop to the ground
to lie in bed; bedridden; bed
a bed (on a train); a couchette
x: 臥室里少一只电灯泡。
Wòshì lǐ shǎo yī zhī diàndēngpào.
There's a light bulb missing in the bedroom.
不得躺臥。
Bùdé tǎngwò.
No lying down here.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

泥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 尼 represents the sound.
x: 我的鞋子沾到泥巴了。
Wǒ de xiézi zhān dào níbā le.
My shoes are stained with mud.
泥很软，我们的脚都陷进去了。
Ní hěn ruǎn, wǒmen de jiǎo dōu xiàn jìnqù le.
The mud was soft and our feet sank in.

撥.o: To dispatch 發 goods by hand 扌

c.h: 礻 is a component form of 示.

祥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 礻 represents the meaning and 羊 represents the sound.
x: 夏天的傍晚是一位慈祥的老奶奶。
Xiàtiān de bàngwǎn shì yīwèi cíxiáng de lǎonǎinǎi.
A summer evening is a kindly old grandmother.

c.h: 辶 is a component form of 辵.

遥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 䍃 represents the sound. Simplified form of 遙.
w: unfettered and beyond the law (idiom); evading retribution
a long way in front; to lead by a wide margin
x: 我的家乡在遥远的北方。
Wǒ de jiāxiāng zài yáoyuǎn de běifāng.
My hometown is in the far north.
电视的遥控器找不到了。
Diànshì de yáokòngqì zhǎo bù dào le.
I can't find the TV remote control.

弥.o: Phonosemantic compound. 弓 represents the meaning and 尔 represents the sound. Simplified form of 彌.
w: to complement; to make up for a deficiency
to pervade; to fill the air; diffuse
to dissipate everywhere (of light, sound, gas etc)
seriously ill and about to die
to cause a wound to close up and heal
trying to hide it makes it more conspicuous (idiom); A cover up…
x: 我要弥补我的过错。
Wǒ yào míbǔ wǒ de guòcuò.
I want to make amends for what I did.
他因为自己的愚蠢，多次错过了弥补亏损的机会。
Tā yīnwèi zìjǐ de yúchǔn, duōcì cuòguò le míbǔ kuīsǔn de jīhuì.
Because of his stupidity, he missed multiple opportunities to regain his losses.

c.h: 彳 is a component form of 行. Originally depicted a shoe.
Depicts a head on top of a person.
夂 is a component form of 止. Depicts a foot.

履.o: Depicts a person (頁) using their foot (夂) to tread. 眉 was later added to embellish the character and to represent the sound while a component that depicts a shoe was also later added to 夂 (foot) to emphasize another meaning "shoes". The component that depicts a shoe was later reanalyzed as meaning component 彳 (walk).
w: lit. as if walking on thin ice (idiom)
to keep a promise; to honor an agreement
caterpillar track (propulsion system used on bulldozers etc)
x: 我们应该履行自己的责任。
Wǒmen yīnggāi lǚxíng zìjǐ de zérèn.
We should fulfil our own responsibilities.
他的工作履历很丰富。
Tā de gōngzuò lǚlì hěn fēngfù.
He has a rich work history.

c.h: 爫 is a component form of 爪.

妥.o: Depicts a hand (爫) calming a woman (女) down. The meaning later shifted to "adequate", "suitable", and "satisfactory".
w: to compromise; to reach terms; a compromise
to arrange; to settle; to complete
x: 双方都做了妥协以求和平。
Shuāngfāng dōu zuò le tuǒxié yǐqiú hépíng.
Both sides have made compromises in order to achieve peace.
贵重物品请自行妥善保管。
Guìzhòng wùpǐn qǐng zìxíng tuǒshàn bǎoguǎn.
Please keep your valuables with you.
我们决不妥协。
Wǒmen juébù tuǒxié.
We will never compromise.
